key_insight: Detonation-spray parameters control the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: Selecting nozzle traverse speed and spray distance can help engineers tailor coating surfaces for greater water repellency.
method: Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Develop predictive equations and identify conditions maximizing hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between traverse speed and roughness/thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical process window or validation metrics, so the predictive equations require verification before production use.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
